events.description: Chandler Bing says the lengthy wait for service is unbelievable.
Chandler Bing says the wait time has been about half an hour.
Chandler Bing says the current waiting situation would be like a cartoon.
Chandler Bing says Joey Tribbiani would be looking like a ham right now if the situation were a cartoon.
Joey Tribbiani says Ursula Buffay, the waitress, is there right now.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani is trying to get Ursula Buffay's attention by saying, "Excuse me, Miss."
Chandler Bing says the waitress is Phoebe Buffay.
Ursula Buffay asks whether Chandler Bing and Joey Tribbiani are finished ordering.
Chandler Bing tells Ursula Buffay to wait.
Chandler Bing asks what Ursula Buffay is doing here at this restaurant right now.
Ursula Buffay says Ursula Buffay was over there earlier.
Ursula Buffay says Joey Tribbiani said, "Excuse me, hello Miss."
Ursula Buffay says Ursula Buffay is here now at Chandler Bing and Joey Tribbiani's table.
Joey Tribbiani asks why Ursula Buffay is working here at this restaurant.
Ursula Buffay says this restaurant is close to where Ursula Buffay lives.
Ursula Buffay says Ursula Buffay lives nearby.
Ursula Buffay says the aprons at this restaurant are really cute.
Chandler Bing suggests that Chandler Bing, Joey Tribbiani, and Ursula Buffay start over in their interaction.
Ursula Buffay says Ursula Buffay is going to be over at another spot now.
